page.layout: One text column, full width. Within it a centred block of four Arabic lines set as a quotation, followed by the Latin text. Below the text, the signature "Rr 4" at centre. At bottom left, a stray Arabic-looking mark, not text.

main_text.p: illius ad eosdem : quod vobis dico, omnibus dico. Hinc recepti sunt Canones sanctorum Conciliorum, & Principum sanctorum Doctorum, uti sunt Iulij Patriarchæ Romæ, Basilij Episcopi Cæsareæ, & aliorum huius notæ. Idem cap. 4. De Patriarchis, inter ea, quæ obseruare Patriarcha tenetur, hanc primo recenset loco conditionem :

ويلزمهم [?] ـــــــــ [illegible, ~3 letters] من امورهم خمسة أشيا احدها حفظ الدين على اصوله المقررة وما ذ[?]ـــ عند الاجماع من اقوال الرسول ثم الجامع المقبوله ثم الا[?] الحسن على قو[?]ـــــ اقوال [?]ـــ

Tenetur autem ad quinque; Unum est observare Religionem iuxta constantia principia, & quod confirmatum est communi consensu, seu traditionibus ex dictis Apostolorum: Deinde receptorum Conciliorum, demum Patrum, quorum unanimis consensus dicta acceptat.

Ex Nestorianis. Iesuiab Patriarcha, & Scriptor perantiquus, secundum post sacra Eloquia Patrum Canonibus tribuit locum, sic in Præfatione ad tractatum de Iudiciis Ecclesiasticis, tam universalibus, quam particularibus scribens:

page.notes: The Arabic block is set in Arabic script and is transcribed approximately; several words and the ends of lines are doubtful and marked [?] or illegible. The first Arabic line has an extended dash-like stroke after a short word, read as an elongated line. The Arabic squiggle at bottom left is a stray mark, not a catchword, and is left out. The Latin text is clear except "Iesuiab", which is kept as printed. No running head, no catchword, and no marginal notes are printed on this page. The signature "Rr 4" is printed centred below the text.
